one_line: Nvidia faces major leadership and regulatory challenges following Jensen Huang's resignation, while AI infrastructure and funding rounds continue to grow.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid scandal
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned following an investigation into personal relationships, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO. The leadership change drew calls for transparency from U.S. officials regarding China chip sales, warnings from industry figures about supply chain risks, and investor calls for a measured succession process.

themes.title: Chinese companies access Nvidia chips via Southeast Asia
themes.text: Southeast Asian data centers provided computing power to Chinese companies using Nvidia AI chips, exploiting a gap in U.S. sanctions.

stories.headline: Nvidia chips accessed by Chinese companies in SE Asia data centers

themes.title: AI startups and infrastructure secure new funding
themes.text: Market data platform Databento raised $100 million at a $1.1 billion valuation, TSMC planned a $500 million chip startup fund, Nebuly raised $21 million for AI agent ROI measurement, and Nidus raised $30 million for defense factory robotics.

themes.title: SatBench tracks AI benchmark saturation
themes.text: Ethan Mollick created SatBench, finding that 63% of 173 major AI benchmarks cited by labs since 2023 are now saturated.
